title: Do not only analyze peace. Sing your way into it.
summary: The shabad answers peace not with abstraction but with Bani sung, grace received, and Naam remembered.
takeaway: Sometimes peace enters through voiced devotion before it enters through insight.
lifeApplication: Use your actual voice with one line today instead of keeping everything in mental commentary.

source.shortMeaning: Grace and Guru Bani create a peace that is both rewarding and sustaining.

evidence.coreClaim: Grace and Guru Bani create a peace that is both rewarding and sustaining.
evidence.turn: Forgiveness is not the end of the path; it is what makes peace inhabitable.
evidence.practicalImplication: Use your actual voice with one line today instead of keeping everything in mental commentary.
